title: API keys: save and verify Demo connections
content: Home → AYARLAR (Settings), or mobile Menu → Bağlantılar (Connections), opens API & Connection Center. Enter only Demo/Testnet credentials in Demo API Key and Demo Secret Key, select SAVE SECURELY, then VERIFY DEMO CONNECTION to test and activate the saved connection. Saving alone does not verify the connection or grant ARM. For Demo trading, open Home → İŞLEM; RUN DEMO TEST here is a workflow label, not a separate button. Orders still require existing gates. These actions require premium access. LIVE fields on this page do not test, activate or arm LIVE; manage LIVE in Canlı İşlem/Canlı hazırlık (Live Trading/Live preparation).

title: API Secret safety
content: Never share API Secrets, passwords or session tokens with anyone, Kais AI or support messages. Enter a Secret only in the designated connection field; it is stored encrypted and securely and is never shown again. If exposed, revoke the key at the exchange and create a replacement.

title: Demo/Testnet, LIVE and Paper
content: Demo/Testnet uses the exchange test environment and separate keys; LIVE uses a real Binance Futures account and real capital. Do not mix credentials across environments. Paper is an application simulation engine, not the exchange Demo/Testnet account; it is currently disabled and cannot be used. Demo results do not guarantee profit or equivalent LIVE results.

title: Register, verify email, sign in and reset passwords
content: Complete registration on the sign-in screen and accept the terms/privacy notice. Verify your email using the code or link sent to your address, then sign in. Verified membership is required; there is no guest access. If you forgot your password, submit your email using the password-reset option, set a new password from the reset link and sign in again. If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder and try again in a few minutes.

title: Plans and prices: Trial, Smart Trade, Master Mode
content: There are three options. The {TRIAL_DAYS}-day Free Trial needs no payment details, can be used once per account and trades only on the Demo account. SMART TRADE: {SMART_PRICE} {CURRENCY} for {PAID_PERIOD_DAYS} days. It includes Demo and live manual trading, Grid trading, the full Master Trade screen, stop/target/position protection, AI Analyst, Scanner, Analysis Studio, KAIS Guide and KAIS AI; KAIS strategies and Auto Trade are not available on the live account but all of them work on the Demo account. MASTER MODE: {MASTER_PRICE} {CURRENCY} for {PAID_PERIOD_DAYS} days. Everything in Smart Trade plus KAIS strategies and Auto Trade on the live account and priority support. Daily allowances: Smart Trade KAIS AI {KAIS_SMART_DAILY} messages, Chart AI {CHART_SMART_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_SMART_DAILY} analyses; Master Mode KAIS AI {KAIS_PAID_DAILY} messages, Chart AI {CHART_PAID_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_PAID_DAILY} analyses. Payment is made with Binance Pay in {CURRENCY} and there is no automatic renewal. See the plans under Home → ABONELİK (Subscription; mobile: Menu → Abonelik).

title: Renewal, cancellation, refunds and plan changes
content: Paid plans last {PAID_PERIOD_DAYS} days and do not renew automatically; when they end nothing is charged and the plan simply closes, so you do not need to cancel. To continue, pay again before or after the end date. If a payment is approved while your plan is still running, the new {PAID_PERIOD_DAYS} days are added after the current end date, so you keep your remaining days. If you want to move from Smart Trade to Master Mode immediately, write to Support before paying. Your current plan, status and end date are shown at the top of Home → ABONELİK. For refunds, payment or invoice problems, send a request from the Support section. KAIS AI cannot change your subscription or take payments.

title: What is the difference between Smart Trade and Master Mode?
content: Both plans let you trade with real money (live), include the full Master Trade screen. Daily AI allowances: Smart Trade KAIS AI {KAIS_SMART_DAILY} messages, Chart AI {CHART_SMART_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_SMART_DAILY} analyses; Master Mode KAIS AI {KAIS_PAID_DAILY} messages, Chart AI {CHART_PAID_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_PAID_DAILY} analyses. The other difference is automation. With Smart Trade you open live trades manually; KAIS strategies and Auto Trade run only on the Demo account. With Master Mode you can also use KAIS strategies and Auto Trade on the live account, and your support requests are prioritised. Smart Trade costs {SMART_PRICE} {CURRENCY} and Master Mode {MASTER_PRICE} {CURRENCY}; both last {PAID_PERIOD_DAYS} days. KAIS AI is the same assistant on every plan. If you press a live strategy or live Auto Trade button on Smart Trade, the Master Mode card opens so you can upgrade.

title: Free trial: how to start, what is included, what is not
content: The free trial lasts {TRIAL_DAYS} days and needs no payment details. It can be used once per account and requires a verified email; start it under Home → ABONELİK with “Ücretsiz denemeyi başlat” (Start free trial). The trial includes the Master Trade analysis screen, manual and Grid trading on the Demo account, KAIS strategies and Auto Trade on the Demo account, position protection and Scanner. Daily allowances: KAIS AI {KAIS_TRIAL_DAILY} messages, Chart AI {CHART_TRIAL_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_TRIAL_DAILY} analyses. Real-money (live) trading is off during the trial; pressing a live button opens the plans card. Live trading needs Smart Trade or Master Mode. When the trial ends nothing is charged and it does not turn into a paid plan; to continue, choose a plan and pay. If you pay during the trial, the paid {PAID_PERIOD_DAYS} days start after the trial ends, so you keep your remaining trial days.

title: How do I pay with Binance Pay?
content: Payments are made only with Binance Pay in {CURRENCY}; your card or wallet details are not stored. Under Home → ABONELİK (mobile: Menu → Abonelik) choose a plan and press “Binance ile öde” (Pay with Binance). Steps: first, a personal reference code is created. Then send the plan amount (Smart Trade {SMART_PRICE} {CURRENCY}, Master Mode {MASTER_PRICE} {CURRENCY}) with Binance Pay from the Binance app to the Pay ID shown on the payment screen, and write the reference code in the payment note. Finally, enter the Binance transaction/order number on the same screen within {PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS} hours. Every payment is checked and is usually approved within a few hours; once approved your access opens and you get a notification. The payment status (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Expired) is shown on the same screen. If the number is not entered within {PAYMENT_WINDOW_HOURS} hours, the request expires and you can create a new one. For a rejected, long-pending or wrong-amount payment, send a request from the Support section.

title: Daily AI allowances: KAIS AI, Chart AI and AI Analyst
content: On Smart Trade: KAIS AI {KAIS_SMART_DAILY} messages a day, Chart AI {CHART_SMART_DAILY} chart analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_SMART_DAILY} analyses. On Master Mode: KAIS AI {KAIS_PAID_DAILY} messages a day, Chart AI {CHART_PAID_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_PAID_DAILY} analyses. On the free trial: KAIS AI {KAIS_TRIAL_DAILY} messages, Chart AI {CHART_TRIAL_DAILY} analyses, AI Analyst {ANALYST_TRIAL_DAILY} analyses a day. Members without a plan can use Chart AI {CHART_FREE_TOTAL} times in total. The KAIS AI message allowance renews every day at {KAIS_RESET_TIME} Turkey time and the Chart AI allowance at midnight Turkey time. The AI Analyst allowance renews when the {CREDIT_WINDOW_HOURS}-hour window that starts with your first analysis ends. You can see the remaining KAIS AI allowance on the chat counter and the Chart AI allowance at the top of its panel; you can also ask me for your remaining analyses. Chart AI is the “Kais AI'a Sor” button on the Master Trade → Analysis tab: upload a chart image and KAIS explains it; it never places trades.

title: AI Analyst allowance and credits
content: Each fresh AI Analyst analysis uses {ANALYSIS_COST} credits. On Smart Trade the daily allowance is {ANALYST_SMART_DAILY} analyses and on Master Mode {ANALYST_PAID_DAILY}. On the trial and without a plan it is {ANALYST_TRIAL_DAILY} analyses ({ANALYST_BUDGET} credits in total). The window starts with your first analysis and lasts {CREDIT_WINDOW_HOURS} hours; when it ends your allowance refills (not at midnight) and unused analyses do not carry over. Opening the same coin and timeframe again within {ANALYST_CACHE_MINUTES} minutes is free. If an analysis fails, its credits are refunded once. Viewing the Master Trade screen spends no credits. When you ask KAIS AI for a fresh analysis, it asks for your confirmation first.

title: Members without a plan versus paid plans
content: Members without a plan can view Master Trade, use AI Analyst within the daily limit and try Chart AI {CHART_FREE_TOTAL} times in total. Entry/SL/TP levels, decision reasons, Long/Short case details, Trigger Monitor and Scanner top-opportunity details open on the trial and the paid plans. Placing orders, connecting an account and real-money (live) trading need Smart Trade or Master Mode. A paid plan does not skip the safety steps (connection, risk acknowledgement, Consent, ARM, protection). On every plan KAIS AI never gives entry/stop/target levels for an analysis in chat; they are shown on the Master Trade screen.

title: Where are the Master Trade tabs?
content: Home → MASTER TRADE opens /master-trade. Analiz (Analysis) shows decision/scores/MTF and trigger conditions; Canlı İşlem (Live Trading) shows preparation, account and safety gates; Pozisyonlar (Positions) shows open positions, orders, history and performance; Bağlantı (Connection) shows connection/status and risk information. Disconnected or stale account data is not current evidence. Final Decision is not order permission; LIVE execution has separate access and safety requirements.

title: Where are Analyst and Scanner?
content: Home → ANALİST (Analyst) opens the coin selector, filters, scanner snapshot and selected-symbol analysis; mobile bottom navigation includes Analist. Home → TARAMA or mobile Menu → Tarama (Scanner) opens market candidates and signals. A candidate is not an order and scores do not guarantee profit. Fresh Analyst analysis uses credits; do not treat the general Scanner or LIVE Auto Trade scanner as the Analyst purchase flow.

title: Where are Risk, Performance, Operations and Settings?
content: Home → İŞLEM (Trading) opens the Demo trading desk. RİSK opens the Demo Risk Vault with limits, sizing and protection settings. PERFORMANS shows Demo trade results and PnL/risk metrics, not consolidated performance for every LIVE account. OPERASYON shows Demo automation decisions, connection status and trade records; it is not a support service. AYARLAR opens API & Connection Center; mobile Menu → Bağlantılar is the equivalent path. Mobile bottom navigation includes Trading and Performance; other areas are under Menu. CANLI opens the separate real Futures preparation screen.

title: Connection → Consent → ARM → execution safety
content: Save/verify the correct environment connection first; LIVE risk policy acknowledgement, Consent and ARM are separate gates. A paid plan does not bypass them. Demo ARM lasts {DEMO_ARM_MINUTES} minutes; LIVE Consent {LIVE_CONSENT_HOURS} hours; LIVE ARM {LIVE_ARM_HOURS} hours; the supervised LIVE Auto Trade session {AUTO_SESSION_MINUTES} minutes. They are separate timers, not interchangeable permissions. Consent is bound to user/account/key fingerprint scope; renewed Consent disables ARM and Auto Trade and does not implicitly acknowledge the risk policy. Expired Consent stops new entries; its {CONSENT_GRACE_MINUTES}-minute renewal grace is not permission to enter new trades. Risk, Exposure, Protection, One-way and reconciliation gates must also pass. The assistant only explains; it cannot grant permissions or start trading.

title: Final Decision
content: Final Decision is an analysis score/decision view combining components such as Confidence, liquidity, volatility, MTF, freshness and Risk/Reward. Interpret each score in the context of its own screen. It is not order permission, an automatic trading command or a profit guarantee.

title: Confidence
content: Confidence is the analysis engine's signal confidence/alignment score, not a verified probability of winning or a guaranteed success rate. Read it with data freshness and other analysis components.

title: Opportunity Score
content: Opportunity Score ranks potential opportunities. Scanner combines Confidence, MTF alignment, volume, breakout and trap quality; the Master Trade view uses its own decision components. Scores from different screens are not necessarily the same formula or permission to trade.

title: Smart Score
content: Smart Score ranks Analyst snapshot results using Confidence, MTF, trend alignment, RSI, volume, Risk/Reward and volatility. It is not the same measurement as Final Decision or Opportunity Score and is not a verified winning probability.

title: MTF: Multi-Timeframe
content: MTF compares directional/trend alignment across timeframes. Alignment or conflict adds analysis context; missing timeframe data must not be treated as confirmed alignment. It is not order permission by itself.

title: Trigger Monitor
content: Trigger Monitor tracks analysis lifecycle conditions including trend, momentum, volume, breakout/breakdown, MTF, Risk/Reward and freshness. Analysis states such as WAITING/ARMED/TRIGGERED/CONFIRMED are not LIVE ARM permission and do not send orders. Details are premium-locked.

title: Invalidation
content: Invalidation identifies conditions that invalidate an analysis scenario, such as support/resistance loss, MTF conflict, volume deterioration or stale data. An invalid analysis scenario does not mean an exchange position was automatically closed.

title: Risk/Reward
content: Risk/Reward compares target distance to stop distance in the analysis. It is not realized return, win probability or a guaranteed result after fees/slippage. This detail and the trade levels are shown on the trial and the paid plans.

title: LONG / SHORT
content: LONG denotes a bullish analysis/position direction; SHORT denotes a bearish direction. Seeing a direction is not a buy/sell instruction or evidence that an order was opened. The user makes the decision; profit is not guaranteed and capital can be lost.

title: Entry / SL / TP
content: Entry is the analysis/plan entry level; SL is the stop-loss level and TP denotes profit-taking targets. An analysis level does not prove that an exchange order exists or works. Entry/SL/TP details open on the trial and the paid plans; check the real protection status on the Positions screen.

title: LOCKED
content: LOCKED means the relevant action/detail is closed by access or safety gates. A premium lock is not the same as a connection/Consent/ARM/risk lock. Order permission is withheld until required conditions are verified.

title: ARM / ARMED
content: ARM is a time-limited execution authorization gate, separate for Demo and LIVE. Demo ARM lasts {DEMO_ARM_MINUTES} minutes and LIVE ARM {LIVE_ARM_HOURS} hours. ARMED alone neither opens an order nor bypasses other gates. ARMED in Trigger Monitor is an analysis state, not execution authorization.

title: Consent
content: Consent is the user's explicit acceptance of LIVE risk. Its {LIVE_CONSENT_HOURS}-hour expiry and user/account/key fingerprint scope are checked by the system. Consent is not ARM or risk-policy acknowledgement. Renewed Consent disables ARM and Auto Trade; the assistant cannot grant it.

title: Dry-run
content: Dry-run checks quantity/direction/SL/TP and balance in the form, then uses Binance's test-order feature to validate the order without creating a real order. It does not mean all LIVE entry gates passed, protection orders were installed or a later order can be opened. It requires Smart Trade or Master Mode.

title: Scanner / Candidate
content: Scanner scans markets; a Candidate is a symbol/setup selected for evaluation. A candidate does not prove an order was opened or all risk gates passed. The general Scanner screen, Demo automation scanner and LIVE Auto Trade scanner are different contexts.

title: Exposure
content: Exposure is positions' total nominal market exposure, not the deposited margin. Existing and candidate trade exposure are checked against the risk policy's total exposure limit. The assistant does not guess account-specific limits from help text.

title: Protection
content: Protection is the system's matching of exchange stop/protection orders to a position. An analysis SL is not sufficient evidence. Stale, ambiguous or failed data cannot verify protection; check the Positions screen. KAIS AI reports only results verified from the exchange and how current the data is; without verification (verified=false) it never describes protection as working.

title: Reconciliation
content: Reconciliation compares actual exchange positions/orders/protection with the application's tracking records. Missing or conflicting evidence is not considered safe; unresolved/recovery conditions can lock new entries. The assistant cannot start reconciliation or protection repair.

title: One-way / Hedge
content: One-way holds a single net position direction per symbol; Hedge can hold separate LONG and SHORT sides. The current LIVE entry gate requires One-way; Hedge does not satisfy it. Premium does not bypass the account-mode requirement; the assistant cannot change modes.

title: Fingerprint
content: Fingerprint is a hash-based identifier derived from the API key, not its Secret. It checks whether Consent and account/session scope refer to the same key. A fingerprint alone does not prove connection, ARM or protection readiness.

title: Risk warning
content: Analysis and scores are not investment advice or order permission. Profit is not guaranteed; capital can be lost. Demo history, high Confidence and premium membership do not remove risk. The final trading decision belongs to the user.

title: Live support, sending a request and response time
content: For things Kais AI cannot do (a subscription that did not renew, a payment or refund issue, account access, reporting a bug) send a request to the support team. On desktop open Home → SUPPORT (DESTEK); on mobile tap Menu → Support. The Support screen has common questions and a request form; fill it in and send it, and you can attach a screenshot. Response time depends on request volume; usually your answer appears on the Support screen within a few hours. Turn on notifications to be told when a reply arrives (Settings → Notifications).

title: Site map: what is in each menu?
content: The home page shows workspace cards: TRADING (open and manage trades), MASTER TRADE (professional trading area with Analysis, Live Trading and Positions tabs), ANALYST (market analysis and signals), SCANNER (opportunity scanning), PERFORMANCE (profit, win rate, drawdown), RISK (position and risk control), SUPPORT (questions and request form), SETTINGS (account, security, notifications, API connections) SUBSCRIPTION (plans and billing), the DCA bot and Grid bot pages, KAIS FARMER (automatic position management), STUDIO (quick BUY/SELL) and Coinbase inside Master Trade (manual only). On mobile the same sections are in the Menu; API keys are under Menu → Connections. The person icon at the top right opens the profile menu (profile, security, sign out). The eye icon opens Kais AI.

title: Live Trading guide (Kais Guide / Kais Coach)
content: The Kais Guide at the top of the Live Trading tab walks you through setup in order: Account (Binance connection), Risk setting, Approvals and Start. Each step tells you what to do and takes you to the right place. When everything is ready, press 'Final check and start' and tick the confirmation box; the bot runs only after that and never starts by itself when the page opens. While the bot runs, the guide turns into the Kais Coach and shows status, the next scan and the session time.

title: What does each part of the Live Trading screen do?
content: The status bar at the top shows the bot state (Running, Stopped, Needs attention). The summary cards show total balance, today's profit/loss, available balance and the number of open positions. The Kais Guide / Coach box manages setup and running status. The Live scan box explains the last and next scan and why no trade was opened. Open positions lists open trades with their stop and targets. The Strategy section holds risk and margin settings. Daily summary and Recent events give a short day overview and event log. 'Settings and advanced' gathers risk setting, manual order, recovery and emergency stop in one place.

title: What do the status labels and colors mean?
content: Green: everything is fine. Orange: attention needed but the bot is safe (for example entries on hold or reconnecting). Red: there is a problem; the text on screen says what to do. Running means the bot is scanning; Stopped means it is not looking for new trades. If the connection drops, the screen shows the last verified information with a 'verified earlier' note; do not treat it as current.

title: Live scan: why was no trade opened?
content: The bot scans coins at regular intervals and opens a trade only when every rule is met. No trade usually does not mean something is broken; it means the market had no setup that fit the rules. The 'Why was no trade opened?' box shows the most common reason, and 'Closest to a signal' shows how close the confidence score was to the threshold. 'Last twenty-four hours · where were coins filtered out?' breaks the reasons down by share. This is explanatory only and never changes the rules. The next scan time is shown in the box; if Binance applies a temporary block the bot resumes when it ends.

title: Margin mode: Safe, Medium, Aggressive
content: Margin mode sets the largest share of your balance that can be used as margin on each trade: Safe {MARGIN_SAFE_PERCENT}%, Medium {MARGIN_MID_PERCENT}%, Aggressive {MARGIN_AGGRESSIVE_PERCENT}%. Higher modes mean larger trades, so gains and losses both grow. For each mode the screen shows the margin per trade and an estimate of the largest possible loss at a given stop distance. The total margin cap ({MARGIN_TOTAL_PERCENT}%), every trade's stop-loss, the daily loss limit and the other protections apply in every mode. The mode applies to your account only and can be changed anytime; Medium and Aggressive ask for extra confirmation and changes apply to new entries only.

title: Who takes the trade margin? Binance or Kais?
content: Binance sets aside the trade margin; KaisTrade does not take it. When a trade opens, Binance reserves the margin from your own Binance Futures balance and releases it in your Binance account when the trade closes. Your money always stays in your Binance account; it is not transferred to KaisTrade and KaisTrade cannot withdraw on your behalf. The margin mode only lets you choose the most margin that can be set aside per trade. The actual margin and order rules belong to Binance.

title: Target risk, daily loss limit and real risk
content: The per-trade risk you pick is a target, not a guaranteed real loss. The real loss is calculated per trade from the stop distance and margin limits; the 'If the stop is this far, at most ≈' lines are estimates. If the target cannot be reached with this balance and leverage, the screen says so and a trade can still open with lower risk. When the daily loss limit is reached the bot opens no new trades that day. Losses are possible; this is not investment advice.

title: Session length and Extend session
content: The live bot works inside a session of the length you chose. Before it ends you get a notification and an on-screen warning; use 'Extend session' to add time. When the session ends the bot stops looking for new trades and open positions stay protected by their stop and targets; to continue, restart with 'Final check and start'. A system maintenance restart can also stop the session; the screen then shows 'Stopped'.

title: Open positions and Close position
content: Open positions shows each trade's direction (LONG/SHORT), entry price, current profit/loss, stop and target levels. The position card says whether the stop and targets are registered on the exchange; if that cannot be verified, the card says so. 'Close position' closes at market price and asks for confirmation. With no positions the section says 'No open positions'. If freshness cannot be verified, do not treat the data as current.

title: Turning on notifications and their types
content: Use 'Turn on notifications' in the Live Trading top bar or Profile → Notification settings to get entry, exit, session-end and warning notifications. Your browser or phone asks for permission and you must allow it. Notifications are informational; the bot runs independently of them.

title: Connection tab: Binance connection
content: Master Trade → Connection shows your Binance API connection and its status. For live trading the key needs read and Futures trading permission only; withdrawal permission must never be enabled. The connection is verified read-only when you save it. Never paste your API Secret into chat or send it to anyone.

title: How does Kais Original work?
content: Kais Original scans the number of coins you chose at regular intervals; it opens a trade only when a setup meets the trend, signal and confidence rules together, and otherwise prefers to wait. Every trade gets a stop-loss and profit targets. Risk, margin and daily loss limits follow the settings you chose. No result is guaranteed and losses are possible. This is not investment advice.

title: What can Kais AI do?
content: KAIS AI explains the site's sections, screens and terms; answers questions about plans, prices, Binance Pay payment, the trial, daily allowances and support; and points you to the right menu. If you allow it in your profile, it reads and summarises your own trades, positions and settings; it compares coins and gives a market overview. It knows which screen you are on; ask “what is this?” and it explains that section. It does not trade, give buy/sell advice, change your subscription or take payments, and it never asks for passwords or API Secrets. For things only the support team can do, it points you to the Support section. KAIS AI is the same assistant on every plan; only the daily message allowance differs.

title: What is the DCA bot and how does it work?
content: The DCA bot opens a first trade on the coin you choose using the margin you set. If the price moves against you by the percentage you chose, it makes the planned number of extra buys; each extra buy is larger than the previous one by the multiplier you set. The position's average price changes and the bot closes everything once the profit percentage you chose from the average is reached. A stop is always present and sits beyond the last extra buy; if it triggers, the position closes. LONG expects a rise, SHORT expects a fall. The Kais pick shows the three most suitable coins for the direction side by side; each coin carries a label such as 'AI neutral' or 'No AI signal', which describes the state of the direction signal and is not trading advice. There is a safety limit on how many bots run at once; if it is full, stop one first. There is no profit guarantee and you can lose money.

title: What is the Grid bot?
content: The Grid bot places levels across the price range you choose. In two-way mode it buys as the price falls and sells as it rises; in buy-only mode it buys on drops and sells one level higher; in sell-only mode it sells on rises and buys back one level lower. If the price leaves the range the bot does nothing new. Before starting it live, trying it on the Demo account first is recommended. If the exchange rules cannot be read, the bot does not start for safety. There is no profit guarantee.

title: What is KAIS FARMER?
content: KAIS FARMER is the automatic section that manages opened positions for you. Each position is tracked on its own row; entry, stop and target orders are kept on the exchange. In the open positions list, positions managed by Farmer show a 'KAIS FARMER is managing' label. You follow its status and results on the Farmer page. All safety rules apply unchanged: a stop is mandatory and the daily loss limit is kept. There is no profit guarantee.

title: Studio and quick BUY / SELL
content: Studio is a simple screen for opening and closing trades quickly: pick the coin, press BUY or SELL, and set the stop and target. A stop is mandatory on every trade, and after the trade opens it appears in the Open positions list; the list can arrive a few seconds late from the exchange. You can close the position from Studio or from the Open positions section. The permission and confirmation steps required for live trading apply in Studio as well.

title: Coinbase connection and manual trading
content: Only manual trading is supported for Coinbase; bots and automatic strategies do not run on Coinbase. First you save your Coinbase key in the Connections section; the key is stored encrypted and only the required permissions are requested. Then, in the Coinbase terminal inside Master Trade, you can place a market or limit order and optionally set a target (TP) and a stop. If the stop triggers, the position is closed immediately. You must type the confirmation phrase shown in the confirmation box exactly. This feature may not be open to everyone; if you do not see it, write to the Support section.

title: Smart Profit Protection
content: Smart Profit Protection automatically moves the stop up (down for SHORT) once the position is in profit. When the profit equals the amount you put at risk, the stop is moved to the entry price and you can no longer lose on that trade. The stop follows behind the price and never moves back; if the price turns, the position exits with a profit. The position card shows whether the protection is on. This is not a profit guarantee; if the price moves very fast the exit price can differ.

title: Language and notifications
content: You choose Turkish or English with the language button on the site; the choice is saved in this browser and the page reloads. You turn notifications on in Settings; the browser or phone asks for permission, and if it is blocked you must allow the site in your browser settings. On iPhone, add the site to the Home Screen from the Share menu first to receive notifications. Notifications tell you about important events such as a trade reaching its profit target or stop, the daily limit and maintenance announcements.

title: Maintenance mode and emergency stop
content: In maintenance or emergency mode, new trade entries are paused temporarily; members may see a maintenance screen or a countdown. The stop and target protections of open positions keep running, so existing trades are not left unprotected. When maintenance ends, new entries open again automatically. You can follow the time on the countdown; if the problem lasts long, write to the Support section.

title: Why is Analysis Studio not full screen on iPhone? Add to Home Screen
content: On iPhone, Safari does not let websites hide the address and tab bars, so Analysis Studio cannot fill the whole screen in Safari: browser bars stay at the top and a small gap remains at the bottom. The black area on the left or right is the phone's notch. The fix is to add the site to your Home Screen: open the site in Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom, choose Add to Home Screen, and open KaisTrade from the new icon. Opened that way there are no browser bars and Studio is truly full screen in landscape; phone notifications also work only this way. Add to Home Screen does not work in Chrome or in-app browsers (such as Instagram); open the site in Safari.
